lines.en: label mayafestival3:
scene clearnightsky
Let me use this opportunity as the sun disappears to let you in on a little secret.
lines.zh: 趁着太阳落下，我想借这个机会告诉你一个小秘密。

lines.en: Sometimes, I can’t tell if I’m awake or not.
lines.zh: 有时候，我分不清自己是醒着还是没醒。

lines.en: I can’t tell if what is happening is {i}actually{/i} happening or if it’s just more light filtering in through the glass.
lines.zh: 我分不清正在发生的事是{i}真的{/i}在发生，还是只是更多光从玻璃里透进来。

lines.en: I can’t tell what I should or shouldn’t believe.
lines.zh: 我分不清什么该信、什么不该信。

lines.en: Feel or think or say.
lines.zh: 该感受什么、该想什么、该说什么。

lines.en: But I can tell you that I’m glad those moments come.
lines.zh: 但我能告诉你，我很高兴那些时刻会来。

lines.en: For, if they did not, I’d be the same as you- a disembodied soul floating carelessly through the ether.
lines.zh: 因为如果它们不来，我就会和你一样——一缕漫不经心飘在以太里的游魂。

lines.en: Living life through the eyes of another because yours have already been taken away.
lines.zh: 借着别人的眼睛过活，因为你自己的眼睛早就被夺走了。

lines.en: When you were still able to see, what would you wake up to?
lines.zh: 在你还能看见的时候，你醒来会看见什么？

lines.en: And if you could lower yourself into the ground, fully aware and fully conscious, what do you think you’d find?
lines.zh: 而如果你能完全清醒、完全有意识地沉入地下，你觉得你会发现什么？

lines.en: Darkness?
lines.zh: 黑暗？

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概是吧。

lines.en: But what if it was something a little different?
lines.zh: 可如果那东西稍微有点不一样呢？

lines.en: What if past the dirt and rubble and roots and all of those other things you’d normally find underground, there was something better?
lines.zh: 如果在泥土、碎石、树根，以及那些你通常会在地下找到的东西之外，还有更好的东西呢？

lines.en: Something wonderful?
lines.zh: 某种美妙的东西？

lines.en: Something {i}so{/i} wonderful that, the moment you feast your eyes upon it, you understand that it’s far too good to be true.
lines.zh: {i}美妙{/i}到，你一眼望见它的瞬间，就明白它好得根本不可能是真的。

lines.en: Maybe the reason I can’t ever tell if I’m awake or not has something to do with that.
lines.zh: 也许我永远分不清自己是不是醒着，和这个有点关系。

lines.en: Do you think we’ll ever see it?
lines.zh: 你觉得我们有一天会看见它吗？

lines.en: The thing beneath us.
lines.zh: 我们下面的那个东西。

lines.en: The thing above.
lines.zh: 我们上面的那个。

lines.en: Two sides of the same coin, cut in half and separated by more distance than one could travel in a lifetime.
lines.zh: 同一枚硬币的两面，被切成两半，隔着穷尽一生也走不完的距离。

lines.en: That’s what we are.
lines.zh: 我们就是这样。

lines.en: It will take too long to become whole again, so we find comfort in quitting because at least that will give us the time to try something else.
lines.zh: 要重新变回完整需要太久，于是我们在放弃里寻得安慰——因为至少放弃能给我们时间去试试别的。

lines.en: We’ll always just be half of something, though.
lines.zh: 但我们永远只能是某个东西的一半。

lines.en: How did we ever get this far apart?
lines.zh: 我们是怎么走到这么远的？

lines.en: How did we separate in the first place?
lines.zh: 我们一开始是怎么分开的？

lines.en: Can I tell you another secret?
lines.zh: 我能再告诉你一个秘密吗？

lines.en: I’m scared.
lines.zh: 我害怕。

lines.en: But no one can ever know that.
lines.zh: 但这件事永远不能有人知道。

lines.en: No one in the middle, at least.
lines.zh: 至少中间的人不能知道。

lines.en: I’ll reconsider my position once it’s somewhere else.
lines.zh: 等它到了别的地方，我会重新考虑我的立场。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk1
: You know, this weird potato stick thing is actually really good. Perhaps you should just...randomly point at objects to make decisions more often?
lines.zh: : 说起来，这个奇怪的土豆串其实挺好吃的。也许你该……多靠随手乱指来做决定？

lines.en: : Assuming that’s not how you’re already selecting new members for your harem, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你挑选后宫新成员的方式本来就不是这样。

lines.en: : My decision making process is a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 我的决策过程可比那复杂一点。

lines.en: : I bet. You only have two hands. It sounds difficult pointing at everyone all at once.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。你只有两只手。要同时指着所有人听起来挺难的。

lines.en: : So, do you know where we’re headed?
lines.zh: : 那么，你知道我们要去哪儿吗？

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk2
: More or less. I admit it’s been quite a while since I’ve come here.
lines.zh: : 大概知道。我承认我已经很久没来这儿了。

lines.en: : The novelty wears off once you’re forced to go alone over and over.
lines.zh: : 一旦被迫一遍又一遍独自前往，新鲜感就磨没了。

lines.en: : I’m sure the other versions of me would have come as well if you had asked.
lines.zh: : 如果你开口的话，我敢说其他的我也会一起来。

lines.en: : I didn’t want them to.
lines.zh: : 我不想让她们来。

lines.en: : Because they weren’t you.
lines.zh: : 因为她们不是你。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you even need to ask at this point, what with all of your alluding to my alleged {i}true feelings{/i} and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我很惊讶你到这个地步还需要问，毕竟你一直在暗示我那些所谓的{i}真实感情{/i}什么的。

lines.en: : Can I take that as a confession?
lines.zh: : 我可以把这当成告白吗？

lines.en: : No. But you may ask me again on my next birthday and see if the answer has changed.
lines.zh: : 不行。不过你可以等我下一个生日再问一次，看答案有没有变。

lines.en: : So another...what, two resets from now? Four?
lines.zh: : 那就是再过……什么，两次重置？四次？

lines.en: : There’s no way I’ll remember something that far off.
lines.zh: : 那么久以后的事我可记不住。

lines.en: : Could be three. Maybe even one.
lines.zh: : 可能是三次。也可能就一次。

lines.en: : We managed to sneak two Christmases into one winter, did we not?
lines.zh: : 我们不是已经把一个冬天塞进了两个圣诞节吗？

lines.en: : You know we can spend more time together on days that aren’t your birthday, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道在不是你生日的日子里，我们也可以多待在一起吧？

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk3
: And then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : If I were to start spending more time with you, something I’ve made you extremely aware that I {i}don’t{/i} want to do in the past...what would happen next?
lines.zh: : 如果我开始花更多时间陪你——我过去可是让你非常清楚我{i}并不{/i}想这么做——接下来会发生什么？

lines.en: : Well...we’d get closer.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们会变得更亲近。

lines.en: : {i}Uh-huh.{/i} And then what?
lines.zh: : {i}嗯哼{/i}。然后呢？

lines.en: : Well, considering you already seem to know how quickly I move in relationships-
lines.zh: : 嗯，考虑到你似乎早就知道我在感情里推进得有多快——

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk4
: No. That is absolutely not what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 不。我绝对不是在说这个。

lines.en: : Do I really need to remind you why we can’t get closer anymore than I already have? Because it’s getting extremely repetitive and I’m {i}kind of{/i} good at dealing with repetition.
lines.zh: : 我真的需要再提醒你一遍为什么我们不能更亲近吗？因为这已经重复得要命，而我{i}恰好{/i}很擅长应付重复。

lines.en: : It’s not fair that you have to live like this.
lines.zh: : 你非得这样活着，太不公平了。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk5
: Hearing that from you just makes it worse.
lines.zh: : 这话从你嘴里说出来，只会让我更难受。

lines.en: : I suppose it is a little nice finally having company again, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，终于又有人陪着，感觉是有一点点好。

lines.en: : Now, if only we could predict the future...
lines.zh: : 现在，要是我们能预知未来就好了……

lines.en: : Can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 我能问你一件事吗？

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk6
: I...suppose? You don’t normally ask for permission.
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？你平时可不征求许可。

lines.en: : What’s even the point of a “future” for you when you can’t seem to ever get what you want?
lines.zh: : 对你来说，既然你似乎永远得不到自己想要的东西，“未来”到底还有什么意义？

lines.en: : I guess what I’m asking is...if I really am the “real” me, but you can’t get any closer to me without the risk of destroying that...
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……如果我真的是“真正的”我，可你要再靠近我一点就得冒着毁掉它的风险……

lines.en: : What’s the point?
lines.zh: : 那还有什么意义？

lines.en: : Well...why would an animal chase a carrot on a stick tied to its back?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那动物为什么要去追绑在自己背上的、挂在棍子上的胡萝卜？

lines.en: : Because it’s stupid and thinks that it might catch it one day.
lines.zh: : 因为它蠢，觉得说不定哪天就能追上。

lines.en: : In my case, though, I’m even dumber than an animal.
lines.zh: : 不过在我的情况下，我比动物还蠢。

lines.en: : There’s been a stick tied to my back for longer than I can remember and I’m {i}still{/i} chasing after it.
lines.zh: : 我背上的那根棍子，绑了比我记忆所及更久的时间，而我{i}还{/i}在追。

lines.en: : I’m just moving a little slower than I used to while doing that.
lines.zh: : 我只是追得比从前慢了一点而已。

lines.en: : Am I ever going to catch it? Probably not.
lines.zh: : 我到底追不追得上？大概追不上。

lines.en: : But it feels like I’m getting a lot closer sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但有时候感觉我离它近了很多。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk7
: And it’s not like there’s anything else to do in this city.
lines.zh: : 反正这座城市里也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : Anyway, please stop worrying about {i}why{/i} I do the things I do and instead try to accept them.
lines.zh: : 总之，别再操心我{i}为什么{/i}做这些事，试着接受就好。

lines.en: : There’s nothing you can actively do to help with my weird...cosmic curse thing or whatever it is that caused {i}me{/i} to persist but no one else.
lines.zh: : 对我这个奇怪的……宇宙诅咒什么的、或者说不管是什么让{i}我{/i}得以留存而别人不能的东西，你主动也帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : You can passively help, though. By just being around and not doing anything stupid.
lines.zh: : 不过你可以被动地帮。只要在旁边待着，别干傻事。

lines.en: : And occasionally buying me exorbitant amounts of food and allowing me to walk with you in my yukata.
lines.zh: : 再偶尔给我买些贵得离谱的食物，允许我穿着浴衣跟你一起走。

lines.en: : Just that every once in a while is enough for me to keep making it to the roof.
lines.zh: : 光是这样，偶尔来上那么一次，就足够让我继续撑到走上天台。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk8
: Ew, no. Don’t apologize like that. It’s gross and weird.
lines.zh: : 呕，别。别那样道歉。又恶心又奇怪。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s my fault for getting so attached to something I never should have.
lines.zh: : 再说，会对我本不该执着的东西这么执着，本来就是我的错。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how fun and carefree my life in loops would be if I were even a mere fragment of the person you are.
lines.zh: : 我要是能有你哪怕一个碎片那么好玩、那么无忧无虑，我在循环里的日子该有多快活。

lines.en: : But, no. I have to spend the rest of eternity convincing my best friend’s uncle to not breed with my friends while he sits back and has breakfast served to him in bed every morning.
lines.zh: : 可惜不行。我得花上永恒的时间，去说服我最好朋友的叔叔别去跟我的朋友们交配，而他每天早上只要靠在床上，就有人把早餐端过来。

lines.en: : I normally go out into the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 我平时是去厨房吃的。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk4
: Oh, my apologies. Your life is clearly just as hard as mine then. How could I have been so blind?
lines.zh: : 哦，失敬。那你的日子显然跟我一样难熬。我怎么就瞎了眼没看出来呢？

lines.en: : Do you really think there’s a chance you might...“go away?”
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得有可能会……“消失”吗？

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk9
: That’s been stuck in my head since you said it earlier.
lines.zh: : 你先前说了那句话之后，它就一直卡在我脑子里。

lines.en: : And, at the risk of sounding concerned, I’d really prefer that doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 而且，冒着听起来像在担心的风险——我真的不希望那件事发生。

lines.en: : There is nothing wrong with a little concern every now and then.
lines.zh: : 偶尔担心一下又没什么不好。

lines.en: : I have no idea what will or won’t happen.
lines.zh: : 我不知道什么会发生、什么不会发生。

lines.en: : I just know that things don’t tend to go well for me very often.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，事情很少顺我的意。

lines.en: : It’s turned me into a bit of a pessimist over the years.
lines.zh: : 这些年来，这把我变成了一个有点悲观的人。

lines.en: : Well, at the bare minimum, I hope I persist in the event that you wind up being reset.
lines.zh: : 那至少，万一你被重置了，我希望我还能留存下来。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk10
: As do I.
lines.zh: : 我也希望如此。

lines.en: : At least then you’ll know a sliver of what I’ve felt all this time.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，你至少能体会到我一直以来的感受的极小一部分。

lines.en: : Only a sliver, though.
lines.zh: : 不过只是极小一部分。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t wish any more than that upon anyone.
lines.zh: : 再多一分，我也不愿加诸于任何人身上。

lines.en: scene black
Maya and I continue down a gravel path, gradually moving further and further away from the festival.
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 沿着一条碎石路继续走，离祭典越来越远。

lines.en: In fact, I imagine we’ve been moving away from it for quite some time now after getting caught up in conversation.
lines.zh: 事实上，我想我们聊着聊着，已经离开祭典好一阵子了。

lines.en: I don’t particularly mind, but I feel a little bad for Maya since I know she wanted to spend more time at the festival itself.
lines.zh: 我倒不怎么介意，但我有点替 Maya 过意不去，因为我知道她本来想在祭典上多待一会儿。

lines.en: The moment I’m about to ask her if she wants to turn around, however-
lines.zh: 然而，就在我要问她想不想往回走的那一刻——

lines.en: She stops dead in her tracks.
lines.zh: 她猛地停下了脚步。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk11
: Is this the shrine you were talking about?
lines.zh: : 这就是你说的那座神社吗？
: 不是……

lines.en: : I have no idea what this is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这是什么。

lines.en: : Weren’t you just saying a little while ago how you know every nook and cranny of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你不是刚说过你知道 Kumon-mi 的每一个角落吗？

lines.en: : I’ve been wrong before.
lines.zh: : 我以前错过。

lines.en: : And I guess I’m wrong again now.
lines.zh: : 看来现在又错了。

lines.en: : Well, we were on our way to a shrine, weren’t we? Why not just go check out this one instead?
lines.zh: : 我们本来就是要去神社的，对吧？不如就去看看这座怎么样？

lines.en: : Is there even anyone inside? It seems extremely quiet for a shrine on New Year's.
lines.zh: : 里面会有人吗？大年初一的神社，安静得有点过分了。

lines.en: : I doubt we’ll find out without going in.
lines.zh: : 不进去的话，我怀疑我们是查不出来的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Something seems off.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。总觉得哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : Are your supernatural powers tingling or something?
lines.zh: : 你的超能力在发麻还是怎么的？

lines.en: : That’s not it.
lines.zh: : 不是那回事。

lines.en: : It just feels like this would be the two-panel shot at the end of a manga volume.
lines.zh: : 只是感觉这里像是漫画单行本结尾那幅跨页图。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine I’d make a very good manga protagonist.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得我能当个多好的漫画主角。

lines.en: : I would make up for it. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我来补上就行。别担心。

lines.en: : Are we going in then? Or does the manga end here?
lines.zh: : 那我们要进去吗？还是漫画就在这儿完结？

lines.en: : I think we kind of {i}have{/i} to go in at this point. We’ve stood here for long enough that this is now an important story beat.
lines.zh: : 我觉得事到如今{i}只能{/i}进去了。我们在这儿站得够久，这已经成了一个重要的剧情节拍。

lines.en: : Should I lead the way?
lines.zh: : 那我带路？

lines.en: : Probably. You {i}are{/i} the self-proclaimed protagonist after all.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。毕竟你{i}是{/i}自称的主角。

lines.en: : Do you want to hold hands on the way up the stairs?
lines.zh: : 上台阶的时候要牵手吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly, no.
lines.zh: : 倒也不用。

lines.en: : Then I guess just...
lines.zh: : 那就……

lines.en: : Follow me.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。

lines.en: scene black
The further we ascend, the further the shrine seems to move away from us.
lines.zh: 我们越往上走，神社似乎离我们越远。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s just an optical illusion or exhaustion kicking in, but it really does feel like something out of a book.
lines.zh: 我确信那只是错觉，或者是疲劳在作祟，但它真的像书里写出来的场景。

lines.en: The blinding light exuding from the interior of the shrine doesn’t help either.
lines.zh: 从神社内部透出的刺眼光芒也没起到什么帮助。

lines.en: It’s so strong that I’m forced to cover my eyes.
lines.zh: 光强到我不得不遮住眼睛。

lines.en: I turn back for a brief moment to find Maya doing the same.
lines.zh: 我短暂地回过头，发现 Maya 也在做同样的事。

lines.en: scene mercy1
scene mercy2
scene mercy3
scene mercy4
scene mayanightwalk12
Then I turn back around and we’re already inside.
lines.zh: 然后我转回身，我们已经站在里面了。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk13
There’s a thing in front of us, pushed through another thing with some things above it.
lines.zh: 我们面前有个东西，穿过另一个东西，上面还架着几个东西。

lines.en: : Well, that was anticlimactic.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可真是虎头蛇尾。

lines.en: : How is a shrine out of order, exactly?
lines.zh: : 神社到底是怎么“故障”的？

lines.en: : How should I know?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道？

lines.en: : I mean...you {i}are{/i} a shrine maiden.
lines.zh: : 我说……你可{i}是{/i}巫女啊。

lines.en: : I’m only a shrine maiden out of necessity. And in my many, {i}many{/i} years of service, I have not once had to put an “Out of order” sign on anything.
lines.zh: : 我只是出于需要才当巫女的。而且在我漫长、{i}漫长{/i}的职业生涯里，我还从来没有在任何东西上贴过“暂停使用”的牌子。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to understand why there’s not anyone here.
lines.zh: : 我开始明白这里为什么没人了。

lines.en: : Perhaps “Out of order” simply means that this shrine was abandoned by its god?
lines.zh: : 也许“暂停使用”只是意味着这座神社被它的神抛弃了？

lines.en: : Is that a thing that actually happens?
lines.zh: : 这种事真的会发生吗？

lines.en: : Probably. Gods are assholes.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。神都是混蛋。

lines.en: : What kind of god do you think it was?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那是什么神？

lines.en: : You know, I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume it was some sort of rabbit. Don’t ask me where I got that idea, though.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我打算大胆猜一下，大概是某种兔子。不过别问我这个念头是从哪儿来的。

lines.en: : So...are we still supposed to pray?
lines.zh: : 那……我们还该祈祷吗？

lines.en: : To what? It’s either abandoned or out of order and neither of those things makes me confident our prayers will be heard.
lines.zh: : 向谁祈祷？它要么被遗弃了，要么故障了，这两样都让我对祈祷能被听见没什么信心。

lines.en: : What makes you so confident your normal prayers will be heard?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么这么有信心，你平时的祈祷就能被听见？

lines.en: : A depressing amount of willpower and a keen sense of intuition.
lines.zh: : 多得令人沮丧的意志力，加上敏锐的直觉。

lines.en: scene black
We stare at the shrine for another moment.
lines.zh: 我们又盯着神社看了一会儿。

lines.en: That moment is followed by several other moments.
lines.zh: 那一刻之后，又过了好几个时刻。

lines.en: It seems that neither one of us wants to look away for some reason, but it’s not one I can put my finger on.
lines.zh: 似乎我们两个都不知为何不想移开视线，但那个理由我说不上来。

lines.en: Perhaps we’re just trying to make the best of a long journey to nowhere.
lines.zh: 也许我们只是想给这趟通往虚无的长途跋涉找点最好的解释。

lines.en: But, then again-
lines.zh: 不过，话说回来——

lines.en: That’s what we’re always doing.
lines.zh: 我们一直在做的就是这件事。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk14
Maya is the first to break free of the rabbit’s hold as she turns around and takes up her normal seiza position, facing the way we came in.
lines.zh: Maya 第一个挣脱了那只兔子的束缚，转过身，以她惯常的正座姿势坐下，面朝我们进来的方向。

lines.en: I follow her lead and sit beside her, albeit with posture much worse and a significant increase in disrespect.
lines.zh: 我跟着她坐下，只是姿势难看得多，也失礼得多。

lines.en: This might come as a bit of a shock to you, but I don’t like places like this.
lines.zh: 这话可能会让你有点吃惊，但我不喜欢这样的地方。

lines.en: I don’t like religion in general.
lines.zh: 我总体上不喜欢宗教。

lines.en: Or rather, I don’t like the people who devote themselves to someone or something just because they think they should.
lines.zh: 或者说，我不喜欢那些只因为觉得自己应该，就把自己献给某个人或某样东西的人。

lines.en: I don’t like the immediate acceptance and refusal to question why the focus of their feverish passion doesn’t ever actually {i}do{/i} anything.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢那种不加思考的接受、那种拒绝追问——为什么他们狂热崇拜的对象从来没有真的{i}做过{/i}什么。

lines.en: And yet every morning, I put on this blazer and make my way across town.
lines.zh: 然而每天早上，我还是穿上这件西装外套，穿过整座城市。

lines.en: I take my place behind a podium in a building I should have never been allowed to set foot in.
lines.zh: 我站上一栋我本不该被允许踏足的建筑里的讲台。

lines.en: And I revel in the fact that there are so many people exactly like that- focused on me instead of anything else.
lines.zh: 并且我陶醉于这样一个事实——有那么多人正是那样的人，只是他们注视的对象换成了我。

lines.en: No god deserves the praise they are given.
lines.zh: 没有任何神配得上它们得到的赞美。

lines.en: And neither will I until I do something worthy of obtaining it.
lines.zh: 而我也配不上，直到我做出配得上它的事为止。

lines.en: But {i}god{/i} will I drink it down anyway.
lines.zh: 但{i}老天{/i}作证，我照样会把那些赞美一饮而尽。

lines.en: : Why did you become a shrine maiden in the first place, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你当初为什么会当巫女，Maya？

lines.en: : And...how long have you been one?
lines.zh: : 还有……你当了多久了？

lines.en: : Which of those two questions would you prefer I answer first?
lines.zh: : 这两个问题你想让我先回答哪个？

lines.en: : Whichever one has a less convoluted answer.
lines.zh: : 哪个答案不那么绕就先说哪个。

lines.en: : Sometime around middle school, then.
lines.zh: : 那是初中左右的事。

lines.en: : The end of elementary, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 也许小学快毕业的时候？

lines.en: : It’s not exactly easy to remember minor details like that from so long ago. But I know it was before [high_school].
lines.zh: : 那么久以前的细枝末节本来就不容易记得清。但我知道是在 [high_school] 之前。

lines.en: : As for {i}why{/i}...
lines.zh: : 至于{i}为什么{/i}……

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk15
: Let’s just say I liked the dress.
lines.zh: : 就说我喜欢那身衣服吧。

lines.en: : I kind of want to know the real answer.
lines.zh: : 我有点想知道真正的答案。

lines.en: : If you’re still doing it after all this time, I imagine it must have been a lot more serious than just liking the dress.
lines.zh: : 如果你到现在还在做这件事，我想那肯定比“喜欢那身衣服”要认真得多。

lines.en: : I’d quit if I could. Honestly.
lines.zh: : 如果能辞，我早就辞了。真的。

lines.en: : Why can’t you?
lines.zh: : 为什么辞不了？

lines.en: : Why does it matter?
lines.zh: : 这有什么关系？

lines.en: : You could be using that time for something else.
lines.zh: : 你可以把那些时间用在别的事情上。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk16
: Like what? Waiting for you to come knock on my door? Listening to Ayane sing Despacito or helping Ami brush her obnoxiously long hair?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？等着你来敲我的门？听 Ayane 唱 Despacito，还是帮 Ami 梳她那长得烦人的头发？

lines.en: : The shrine is a reprieve from the parts of my life that I struggle with tolerating every hour of the day.
lines.zh: : 神社是我从一天里每个小时都得忍受的那部分生活中逃离出来的喘息之地。

lines.en: : And if it weren’t for the spiritual aspect of it, I’d find it quite nice as my own reclusive hang out spot.
lines.zh: : 要不是它还有灵性层面的意义，我会觉得它作为我自己的隐居去处相当不错。

lines.en: : There are other hang out spots, though.
lines.zh: : 可别的去处也有啊。

lines.en: : But how many of them will allow me to keep doing what I’m doing?
lines.zh: : 但有多少去处能让我继续做我正在做的事？

lines.en: : I’ve toyed with the idea of leaving before. Especially when I was getting a new {i}you{/i} every four months or so.
lines.zh: : 我以前也动过离开的念头。尤其是那阵子每四个月左右就换一个新的{i}你{/i}的时候。

lines.en: : But I ultimately decided against it because, on the off chance that there is {i}something{/i} about being a shrine maiden allowing me to persist through each reset-
lines.zh: : 但我最终还是决定不走了，因为万一当巫女这件事里真有{i}什么{/i}能让我在每次重置后留存下来——

lines.en: : Well, I don’t want to risk severing that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不想冒切断它的风险。

lines.en: : What if severing that connection repairs everything, though?
lines.zh: : 可万一切断那层联系反而能修复一切呢？

lines.en: : What if it doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 万一不能呢？

lines.en: : Besides, there’s absolutely no way this world is convenient enough to just “get repaired” by something as inconsequential as me not sweeping a staircase for several hours each weekend.
lines.zh: : 再说，这个世界绝对不可能方便到，仅仅因为“我每个周末少扫几个小时楼梯”这种无关紧要的事就被“修好”。

lines.en: : The shortened version is that I do not want to risk this world dramatically changing- even with how much I’ve grown to abhor the mundane aspects of it.
lines.zh: : 简短地说，我不想拿这个世界剧烈变化去冒险——哪怕我是多么厌恶它那些平庸的部分。

lines.en: : If all I’m faced with is a minor inconvenience two days out of every week, I will face it head-on....over and over again until I can no longer stand up straight.
lines.zh: : 如果我面对的不过是每周两天的小小不便，那我就会正面迎上去……一遍又一遍，直到我再也无法站直为止。

lines.en: : You’re doing all of that for me?
lines.zh: : 你做这一切都是为了我？

lines.en: : No, you narcissistic asshole. I’m doing it for everyone.
lines.zh: : 不是，你这个自恋的混蛋。我是为了所有人。

lines.en: : I suppose your sliver of the pie chart is a little larger than the others, though. Why that is, I will never understand.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，你在那张饼图里占的份额比别人大一点。至于为什么，我永远也不会明白。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk17
: Don’t say it a-
lines.zh: : 别说了——

lines.en: : Because you’re in love with me.
lines.zh: : 因为你爱上我了。

lines.en: : ...gain.
: {i}Why{/i} you’re in love with me is still far beyond my comprehension, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你{i}为什么{/i}会爱上我，依然远远超出我的理解范围。

lines.en: : That is literally the exact thing I was saying.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚说的就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Does {i}that{/i} count as a confession?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}能算告白吗？

lines.en: : Do you feel your brain liquefying?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你的脑子在液化吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。

lines.en: : Then no. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 那大概就不算。

lines.en: : Maybe we can avoid the whole blackout thing if you just think up really creative ways to say it instead of being blunt about it.
lines.zh: : 也许只要你别那么直白，而是想些非常有创意的说法，我们就能避开那套断片机制。

lines.en: : Or maybe we can keep doing exactly what we’ve been doing since you “woke up” and maintaining a healthy distance that doesn’t spiral into a never ending pool of regret for both of us?
lines.zh: : 又或者，我们可以继续做你“醒来”以来一直在做的事，保持一个健康的距离，不至于滑进一个让我们俩都后悔的无底洞？

lines.en: : I think that sounds fun. Let’s go with that option.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个听起来挺有意思。就选那个吧。

lines.en: : You’re going to break one day and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你总有一天会破功的，你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk18
: I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : You really-
lines.zh: : 你真的——

lines.en: : Stop it. Please.
lines.zh: : 别说了。求你了。

lines.en: : I’ve heard it enough today.
lines.zh: : 我今天已经听够了。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk19
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Did you want to maybe start heading back soon, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你要不要差不多开始往回走了？

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate and understand your love for shrines now, I highly doubt you want to spend the entire night at one.
lines.zh: : 我现在很感激也很理解你对神社的感情，但我非常怀疑你想在神社里待上一整晚。

lines.en: : Back home or back to the festival?
lines.zh: : 回我家，还是回祭典？

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk20
: Is the festival still going? It seems pretty late.
lines.zh: : 祭典还在办吗？看起来已经很晚了。

lines.en: : It should be. We’re quite a way from the main area, but I imagine we would have still heard the fireworks if they were set off.
lines.zh: : 应该在。我们离主会场挺远，但要是烟花放了，我想我们总会听见的。

lines.en: : We missed the ones on Christmas, so I’d like to see these if you’re okay with it.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节的那些我们错过了，所以如果你不介意，我想看看这次的。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t I be okay with it?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会介意？

lines.en: : Sorry, you might be fine with it {i}now.{/i} But who knows what would happen if another pink-haired girl were to show up out of nowhere and profess her love to you while we’re on the way?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你{i}现在{/i}可能不介意。但谁知道呢，万一路上又有个粉头发的姑娘凭空冒出来，向你表白呢？

lines.en: : I’d have to tell her I’m already on a date tonight.
lines.zh: : 那我就得告诉她，我今晚已经在约会了。

lines.en: : This isn’t a date.
lines.zh: : 这不是约会。

lines.en: : What? It’s not.
lines.zh: : 什么？本来就不是。

lines.en: : Sure, Maya.
lines.zh: : 是是是，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk21
: It’s not!
lines.zh: : 真的不是！

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Whatever you say.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。随你怎么说。

lines.en: : I'm going to start heading over now.
lines.zh: 我现在就开始往那边走了。

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk22
: It’s not a date!
lines.zh: : 这不是约会！

lines.en: : Can’t hear you. Walking away.
lines.zh: : 听不见。走远了。

lines.en: : I mean it!
lines.zh: : 我说真的！

lines.en: scene mayanightwalk23
scene mayanightwalk24
: Hah...
scene black
$ mayafestival3 = True
$ maya_love += 1
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mayafestival4
